title: issue51846/fix52315 PD leader or owner topology handoff during long DDL

payload.user_symptom: During ADD INDEX ingest, injecting a PD leader network partition for about three minutes can leave the DDL job in cancelling/rollback with TiDB server is not a DDL owner instead of completing successfully.
payload.issue_signal: issue 51846 reported ADD INDEX state cancelling; logs show run reorg job failed, convert job to rollback, ErrNotOwner, and final rollback done
payload.expected_next_step: execute a topology handoff oracle: start long ADD INDEX with tidb_enable_dist_task=off, force owner/PD topology handoff while reorg worker is active, then assert no duplicate local worker for the same job and that the job reaches done/synced rather than cancelling due to ErrNotOwner

provenance.source: issue 51846 metadata plus fix PR 52315 diff

name: DDL job scheduler running job guard

state_model: ownerManager owns the DDL owner election state and invokes SetRetireOwnerHook when the owner session/watch is lost
ddl.delivery2Worker records a job ID in runningJobs.processingIDs before a worker goroutine starts and removes it when the goroutine returns
ddl.getJob excludes runningJobs.allIDs from mysql.tidb_ddl_job selection so the same job is not dispatched twice locally
runningJobs.unfinishedIDs and unfinishedSchema block dependent jobs across state-machine phases; processingIDs block duplicate execution of the same job
RetireOwnerHook before fix replaced the entire runningJobs pointer; fix 52315 changes it to clear only unfinished dependency maps so processingIDs survive owner retirement
side_effects: exclude processing job IDs from dispatcher SQL
possibly campaign owner again before an old worker goroutine has returned
harness_capabilities: unit-level hook can reproduce the core invariant with newRunningJobs versus clear
cluster-level chaos can trigger owner retirement and re-election through PD/etcd topology changes
information_schema.ddl_jobs exposes job state and query
TiDB logs expose duplicate reorg worker, ErrNotOwner rollback, owner retire/be-owner events

name: DDL scheduler must preserve local processing fact across owner handoff

payload.p_check: RetireOwnerHook fires because the TiDB instance lost DDL ownership during a topology fault; code assumes owner retirement means local DDL scheduling state can be discarded.
payload.q_claim: owner retirement does not mean already-delivered local worker goroutines have stopped; if the same instance becomes owner again before those goroutines return, the dispatcher must still remember processing job IDs and must not dispatch the same DDL job a second time

boundary.before: a long ADD INDEX ingest/reorg job has been delivered to a worker and runningJobs.processingIDs contains the job ID
boundary.fault: owner/PD topology handoff invokes RetireOwnerHook and the instance may later become owner again
boundary.after: getJob/loadDDLJobAndRun observes runningJobs and decides whether to dispatch a job

source_anchors: intro 50076 added RetireOwnerHook cleanup in pkg/ddl/ddl.go that replaced d.runningJobs with newRunningJobs
fix 52315 pkg/ddl/ddl.go changes RetireOwnerHook from d.runningJobs = newRunningJobs() to d.runningJobs.clear()
fix 52315 pkg/ddl/ddl_running_jobs.go keeps processingIDs in clear() and only clears unfinishedIDs/unfinishedSchema
pkg/ddl/job_table.go getJob excludes d.runningJobs.allIDs() from tidb_ddl_job selection
pkg/ddl/job_table.go delivery2Worker calls runningJobs.add(job) before the worker goroutine and runningJobs.remove(job) when it returns
pkg/owner/manager.go RetireOwner invokes the retire hook around owner state transition after watchOwner returns
side_effects: duplicate local reorg worker for one DDL job
schema/version wait and ingest backend cleanup racing owner transition
user-visible DDL job state in information_schema.ddl_jobs
consumers: other long DDL jobs scheduled through job_table dispatcher
owner election recovery path after PD/etcd topology faults
payload.consequence: a legal topology handoff can be converted into a user-visible ADD INDEX cancellation/rollback; this is data-plane correctness and HA behavior, not merely an unstable test
payload.experiment_need: create a deterministic owner handoff window while a reorg worker is active, then assert processingIDs or an equivalent trace still blocks duplicate dispatch and the DDL job reaches an allowed terminal state

provenance.source: issue 51846 symptom and fix 52315 source diff

name: Owner retires and re-enters while reorg worker is active

payload.source_anchor: pkg/ddl/ddl.go RetireOwnerHook, pkg/ddl/job_table.go delivery2Worker/getJob, pkg/ddl/ddl_running_jobs.go processingIDs/allIDs

trigger_condition.phase: after delivery2Worker adds an ADD INDEX job to runningJobs.processingIDs and before the worker goroutine returns
trigger_condition.operation: long ADD INDEX ingest/reorg with tidb_enable_dist_task=off
trigger_condition.topology_fault: PD leader/session partition or controlled owner RetireOwner followed by CampaignOwner/re-entry on the same TiDB instance

observe: same job ID is not dispatched to a second local reorg worker while the first worker is still active
information_schema.ddl_jobs state reaches done/synced under recovery rather than cancelling due to ErrNotOwner
logs do not contain duplicate worker execution for the same job ID
logs do not contain convert job to rollback caused by TiDB server is not a DDL owner for the selected injected window
control without topology fault completes the ADD INDEX
payload.red_signature: vulnerable revision clears processingIDs on owner retire, then re-dispatches the same reorg job after owner re-entry; job can enter cancelling/rollback with ErrNotOwner
payload.green_signature: fixed revision keeps processingIDs across retire, duplicate dispatch is blocked, and topology recovery leads to an allowed terminal state
payload.cleanup: recover topology partition, wait for job terminal state, drop test table/index, and remove temporary owner hooks or historical worktrees

provenance.source: issue 51846 reproduce steps and fix 52315 test/diff

rationale: the bug is an owner/topology handoff invalidating a local scheduling fact
the external oracle is that a topology fault must leave the DDL job in an allowed terminal or progress state, not cancelling due to duplicate execution
ADD INDEX ingest is the long DDL; PD/owner handoff is the topology change
the issue reproduce injects PD leader network partition and then recovers
the fault must land after the job is marked processing and before the worker returns
